children: China property services firm's H1 revenue rose 4.5% yr/yr to RMB6.94 bln
Net profit attributable to owners increased 9.5% to RMB517 mln for the period
Company did not recommend payment of an interim dividend for H1 2026
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for the current or future periods
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT EXPANSION – Basic property-management revenue rose 3.9% as managed GFA increased and enhanced services improved fee collection
COMMUNITY SERVICES GROWTH – Community living revenue rose 17.9%, driven by expanded to-home services, drinking-water and charging offerings, tourism and retail categories
